info.description:
## 📧 Mail Endpoints

Dev-only endpoints for testing email delivery.

### Test Welcome Email

`POST /api/mail/test-welcome` — Sends the welcome business email without registering. **Only available when NODE_ENV=development.**

Use this to test the welcome email when your email is already registered (e.g. Resend sandbox only accepts altamirano.developer@gmail.com).
